response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software craftsman with a strong background in web development, Node.js, TypeScript, and DLang. However, he falls significantly short of the core mandatory requirements for this role. He lacks the required 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development experience on Windows, possessing only 7 months of professional C++ experience from 2015. Additionally, he lacks the deep domain expertise required in Fixed Income, Investment Banking, or Capital Markets.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (15+ years) with strong fundamentals in CI/CD, TDD, and system architecture.
Some exposure to the financial sector through his work at RIDE Capital reshaping investment practices.
Demonstrated proficiency with desirable skills like Java development, scripting languages, and CI/CD pipelines.
concerns: Critically lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience, having only 7 months of professional C++ experience from 2015.
No demonstrated extensive experience developing C++ applications specifically for the Windows platform.
Missing required specialized domain knowledge in Fixed Income, Investment Banking, or Capital Markets.
